title: fall/christmas quilt
text: fall/christmas quilt. I have a queen size bed, but purchased the king size for extra width - thinking I could turn it... but that only works on the plaid underside because the the print with the birds only goes one way... The cotton is quite rough and a little stiff... but as you wash and dry it, I believe it will soften.  The edges seem to be well sewn.  I think it will stand up for several seasons. I use it in the Fall and Winter because in my opinion the colors and print are good for Fall and the holiday season. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I hope this info was helpful to you!
